summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the bhwithbails-inspired Home rebuild and new /api/reviews CRUD. All 6 backend tests pass; all 17 requested Home data-testids present; newsletter + copy-code toasts fire correctly; regression across /vendors, /compare, /calculator, /resources, /login, /admin — all return 200 with no new JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is a single ~250+ line file with many inline sub-sections (Hero, Stats, Meet Erica, Reviews, Vendors, Community, Newsletter). Consider extracting each section into its own component under /components/home/ to improve maintainability.

Repeated 401 console errors (2 per page) originate from an unauth admin/settings fetch that runs on every route including public ones — either gate the call behind auth state or swallow 401 in the fetcher to keep the console clean. Pre-existing (also seen in iteration 14), non-blocking.
Newsletter submit only shows a toast — no backend persistence endpoint yet. Fine for MVP, but flag if a real subscribers list is expected.
vendor-promo-copy-btn uses navigator.clipboard which requires HTTPS/permissions; consider a document.execCommand fallback for older browsers. Toast confirmed working in test.
seed_data_creation: None new. Test creates + deletes one TEST_ prefixed review; leaves the 4 seeded reviews intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (a) GET /api/reviews returns 4 seeded reviews with author/quote/rating/location, no _id leak. (b) /reviews/all + POST + PUT + DELETE all require admin (401 unauth). (c) Full admin CRUD roundtrip works via Bearer token from POST /api/admin/login. (d) Home data-testids present: hero-headline, hero-eyebrow, hero-cta-community, hero-cta-compare, stat-card-{weight,vendors,tools}, meet-erica-card, reviews-section (4 review-card children with filled review-rating-stars), trusted-vendors-grid (14 vendor cards, first=re-seq with vendor-visit-re-seq + vendor-promo-copy-btn-re-seq), pep-match-banner href=/compare, community-circle-grid + community-card-{skool,resources,calc}, newsletter-section + newsletter-email-input + newsletter-submit-btn. (e) Newsletter submit shows toast and clears input. (f) Copy code button shows toast 'Code "ERICA" copied'. (g) Before/After images render with the '−90 LBS' pill (unicode minus U+2212). (h) Regression: /vendors, /compare, /calculator, /resources, /login, /admin all return status 200 with no new JS errors (only pre-existing 401 admin-settings fetch noise). (i) /vendors nickname guide card still present.
